alloy.preparation: Specimens 12 × 12 mm² cut from cold-rolled sheet and embedded in epoxy resin. Wet ground with SiC paper to 1000 grit, degreased with acetone, rinsed with distilled water and dried in air. Specimen/resin interface covered with insulating tape, leaving 1 cm² exposed. 316L supplied by Baosteel. No additional heat treatment is specified for these registered measurements.

test_solution.preparation: NaCl solution made from analytical-grade reagent and distilled water. Aeration/purge and numerical bulk pH are not specified for these measurements.

test_method.procedure_description: PARSTAT MC multichannel potentiostat, saturated calomel reference and platinum-foil auxiliary electrode; working electrode totally immersed, with Pt-100 temperature probe near the specimen. Thermostatically hold the solution at the observation’s temperature and sweep potential at the registered constant rate from OCP until current density exceeds 100 µA/cm². For 317L and 904L, cyclic curves were also measured by reversing toward repassivation; the locked value is the forward pitting/transition-branch result. Scan-rate and 1-/3-M NaCl comparisons retain their own conditions.
test_method.pitting_criterion: Endpoint at current density exceeding 100 µA/cm². The upper transpassive plateau is excluded by the registry, while individual markers near the sharp Z-curve transition retain unresolved pitting/transpassive morphology qualification.

experiments.result_note: Approximate discrete experimental marker; same-temperature visible repeats remain separate. Upper transpassive plateau is excluded. Near the sharp transition, the paper does not assign corrosion morphology to each individual marker, so transition points retain that source ambiguity. Boundary/connecting lines do not create additional outcomes. Bulk Table 1 composition is retained without calculating Fe balance or PREN-derived chemistry. No chloride-ion molarity is calculated from NaCl. The 254SMO 10-min heat-treatment study in Figure 9 and the separate room-temperature 500-s transpassive tests do not supply treatment/temperature/hold settings for these records.

test_method.procedure_description: PARSTAT MC multichannel potentiostat, saturated calomel reference and platinum-foil auxiliary electrode; working electrode totally immersed, with Pt-100 temperature probe near the specimen.
